notes: Shares are fractions of the ZCTA's LAND AREA (AREALAND_PART / AREALAND_ZCTA5), not population; only targets with >= 3% share are kept, largest first.

'county' is the county with the largest land share of the ZCTA (it may not be a target county for ZIPs mostly in a neighbouring county); 'other_county' is the largest other county with >= 3% (if 'county' is not San Joaquin/Alameda, the largest target county instead); 'counties' lists all of them. A land-majority county can differ from where most residents live (e.g. 95391 Mountain House).
'unincorporated_share' is the share of the ZCTA's land not inside any Census place.
'Mountain House CDP' is reported as the city of Mountain House (type 'city'); it incorporated in July 2024, after the 2020 relationship files.
Assembly/Senate districts: California's 2021 Citizens Redistricting Commission maps (2022-2030).
us_house is null for every ZIP: Census publishes no ZCTA relationship file for California's 2026 (Prop 50) congressional map; its cd119 file reflects the old map and was not used.

BASIS: all shares are LAND area. Population weighting was requested but is blocked: the Census Data API (api.census.gov/data/2020/dec/pl) now requires an API key (302 to missing_key.html) and BlockAssign_ST06_CA.zip contains no ZCTA file, so there is no block-to-ZCTA mapping in it. usd/elsd/scsd (school districts) are null for the same reason. See notes.md for the unblock plan.
ZCTAs approximate ZIP Codes; PO-box-only and some unique-ZIP codes have no ZCTA and are absent.
Place and county boundaries are as of 2020; later annexations are not reflected.
